en: You beat Whitney? Then you're strong enough to deal with that wiggling tree on Route 36!
My sister's been waiting by it for days. Take this and give the tree a good squirt.
Go on, give that tree on Route 36 a squirt. My sister's waiting there to see what happens!
My sister says a strange tree is blocking the road on Route 36. It wiggles when you water it, apparently!
I'd lend my SquirtBottle to someone strong enough to handle it. Someone with a Gym Badge from Whitney, say.
Thanks for helping my sister! We sell mulch for berry soil now. They're 200 each.
Oh dear, you don't have enough money.
Come again! A little care goes a long way with berries.
